Hi {inviteeName},

{leaderName} here, a co-leader of the footbag club "{clubName}". Will you join me as a co-leader?

Two things change if you do. Your name appears on the club's page, and your contact email is shown to signed-in members, so anyone looking for the club can reach us. You can also edit the club's details page to keep it current.

To say yes, log in, open Clubs, find "{clubName}", and choose "Volunteer to co-lead". You must be a current member of the club with Tier 1 benefits, and a member can co-lead one club at a time.

If you would rather not, no reply is needed.

-- IFPA platform
